message.text: Containers should not run with allowPrivilegeEscalation

snippet.text:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: kalkan-log-agent
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: kalkan
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.4.2"
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/component: log-agent
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: log-agent
    spec:
      hostNetwork: true
      containers:
        - name: agent
          image: "registry.vulnapp.internal/log-agent:2.1.0"
          volumeMounts:
            - name: varlog
              mountPath: /var/log
              readOnly: true
          securityContext:
            privileged: true
      volumes:
        - name: varlog
          hostPath:
            path: /var/log

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: kalkan-web
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: shop
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: kalkan
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.4.2"
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/component: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: web
    spec:
      hostNetwork: false
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: "registry.vulnapp.internal/shop-web:1.4.2"
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          securityContext:
            privileged: false
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            runAsNonRoot: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
